record_text:
Key points.
Premium. The price of insurance, paid monthly, quarterly, or annually.

In depth.
The premium is what you pay the insurer to keep coverage in force. It reflects risk, coverage limits, deductibles, and discounts. Missing payments can lapse the policy. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
source_note: Sourced: standard insurance knowledge; educational only, not financial advice.
